name: Tarren Mill
summary: Tarren Mill holds the Horde's line in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills, beneath the Alterac Mountains. Once a peaceful human farming village, it is now a Forsaken outpost locked in conflict with Southshore to the south.

sections.title: From Grain to Grave
sections.body: Tarren Mill's fields and mill have fallen silent since the Third War. Before then, it was a thriving farming town loyal to Lordaeron. During the Second War, Alliance forces near the town freed captured high elven archers from orc encampments, securing Quel'Thalas's full commitment to the Alliance of Lordaeron. The town's living inhabitants are gone, replaced by the Forsaken. Its buildings are weathered, its fields barren, and its mill quiet. The Forsaken fortify Tarren Mill against mountain beasts, Syndicate outlaws, and Alliance skirmishers.

sections.title: Front Line of Hillsbrad
sections.body: Tarren Mill is the Horde's forward base in Hillsbrad. Southshore, the Alliance port, lies directly across from it, and the road between the towns has become a warzone. From Tarren Mill, Horde travelers push back against the human farmers and soldiers occupying Hillsbrad, coordinate strikes against dwarven excavators at Dun Garok, and secure the dangerous roads that climb into the snowy crags of the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: Who controls Tarren Mill right now?
aliases: is tarren mill horde or alliance
faq.answer: The Forsaken control Tarren Mill, their main Horde outpost in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why are Tarren Mill and Southshore fighting?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill marks the Forsaken and Horde's southern reach in Lordaeron, while Southshore is the Alliance's last major stronghold in the region. Their closeness drives a struggle for Hillsbrad's fertile land and strategic roads.

faq.q: What was Tarren Mill like before the plague?
faq.answer: Before the plague, Tarren Mill was a peaceful human farming and milling settlement in the Kingdom of Lordaeron. During the Second War, Alliance soldiers freed captive high elven archers near the town, securing Quel'Thalas's military pact with the Alliance of Lordaeron.

faq.q: What threats exist around Tarren Mill besides the Alliance?
faq.answer: Beyond Southshore's forces, Tarren Mill faces Syndicate bandits, highland yetis and ogres from the Alterac peaks, and fierce mountain wildlife in the foothills.

angles.text: Tarren Mill is your only major refuge in the Hillsbrad Foothills, with a bat handler, supplies, and vital military support against Alliance forces from Southshore.
As an undead, taking Tarren Mill extends Queen Sylvanas's southern borders and turns a once-proud Lordaeron farming town into a stronghold against the living.
